Chapter 963  Chapter 21 Everything is Ready (Please Subscribe)_2

Then, with a whoosh, it headed deeper into the Chaos Continent.

The deepest part of the earth.

A tall and robust figure sat there, surrounded and interwoven with Chaos Qi. With each breath, a large amount of Chaos Qi was inhaled and exhaled, and although this figure was only about twenty meters tall, it seemed to contain a universe within.

"Ancient Ming, Ancient Ming," the Chaos Dragon Beast arrived and kept calling out at this moment.

"Hmm?"

After a while, the robust figure, Ancient Ming Venerable, opened his eyes, looking puzzled at his companion.

Although it was commonly believed that the Chaos Dragon Beast was subservient to Ancient Ming Venerable, they were actually equals in status, not a master-servant relationship.

"I sense a crisis, a severe crisis," the Chaos Dragon Beast immediately expressed the crisis it had 'foreseen'.

"Crisis?"

Ancient Ming Venerable was slightly startled in his heart.

Normally, the crises sensed by the Chaos Dragon Beast would happen within a hundred thousand years.

But in these hundred thousand years, he had no plans to leave the Chaos Continent, nor did he intend to let the Chaos Dragon Beast leave.

This means, both of them would stay on the Chaos Continent for a hundred thousand years, and still encounter a crisis under such circumstances?

The Chaos Continent was opened up by Ancient Ming Venerable, serving as his personal domain and refuge. Given his strong abilities combined with a Chaos Dragon Beast nearly at the level of Chaos Realm, meeting a crisis here seemed improbable.

Still facing a crisis?

Ancient Ming Venerable's thoughts were rapidly spinning.

He trusted his companion greatly, not believing there to be any issue with the 'foreseeing' ability.

In the vast Chaos Void, the crises that could threaten a Chaos Venerable were not many, let alone for one hid in their own refuge.

"Don't rush this matter,"

"We still have some buffer time."

Ancient Ming Venerable fell into contemplation.

The crises foreseen by the Chaos Dragon Beast mostly happened within a time frame of ten to a hundred thousand years.

As for within ten thousand years? A thousand, a hundred, or ten years? Very rarely.

If the crisis were to come this swiftly, there would be no point in preparing.

"What level of crisis?"

Ancient Ming Venerable asked again.

This question was crucial; if it were a matter of life and death, he would not hesitate to flee with all his belongings.

What about the Chaos Continent? And the many powerful beings on the Chaos Continent?

When it comes to his own life, Ancient Ming Venerable could not care that much anymore.

"It's not a matter of life and death, but I feel, I might at least be severely injured," the Chaos Dragon Beast hesitated for a while, then said softly.

"Not a matter of life and death?"

Ancient Ming Venerable steadied his spirit; as long as it was not about life and death, it was manageable.

Unless absolutely necessary, he was reluctant to abandon everything and flee.

He had put a lot of effort into this Chaos Continent, and the vast number of lives in the surrounding Chaos Void used this place as a hub for trade and transactions, generating immense profits daily, which made Ancient Ming Venerable somewhat reluctant to give up.

"I will contact my friends right now, to see if anything significant is happening in this region of the Chaos Void." Ancient Ming Venerable immediately started contacting his friends.

Those who could be friends with Ancient Ming Venerable were all at the level of Chaos Venerables, extremely sensitive to intelligence and information.

Moreover, the emergence of a crisis usually doesn't come out of nowhere; it often shows some signs.

As long as they had enough information, they could fully deduce the source of the crisis and how exactly to face it.

...

Virtual World.

Lin Yuan's figure appeared.

"Xiaoyuan..." His parents had been waiting for a long time, and his sister Lin Yi also sat obediently, standing up instantly upon seeing Lin Yuan.

"Is that news true?" mother Lu Qiong asked in a low voice.

The matter of the Galaxy Master overpowering the ancestor of the Tianyu Clan had already spread wildly within the realms of human civilization.

Initially, Lu Qiong and Lin Shoucheng thought it was a rumor. Their son was indeed excellent, but overpowering the ancestor of the Tianyu Clan, an existence comparable to the strongest beings?

It is undoubtedly a fantastical tale.

But the news spreads more and more truly, and the Virtual World network has not debunked this matter.

Furthermore, with Lin Yiyi obtaining much more precise information from the Xia Family, Lin Shoucheng and his wife Lu Qiong realized that perhaps these messages might be true?

"Brother, did you overpower the progenitor of the Tianyu Clan?"

Lin Yiyi couldn't help but blurt out beside him.

Because of this matter, the current head of the Xia Family stepped down, and now her husband is shockingly the new head of the Xia Family.

"It's not exactly overpowering." Lin Yuan shook his head.

If we set aside the factor of the river of time, in reality, Lin Yuan couldn't really do anything to the progenitor of the Tianyu Clan.

Even with all his trump cards out, using Divine Abilities 'World', 'Tear the Sky', and other methods, it only caused the progenitor of the Tianyu Clan some headaches.

Beneath the disparity in understanding the Spatiotemporal Fusion Rule, the opponent couldn't possibly pinpoint Lin Yuan's position; he could only passively take hits.

In Lin Yuan's view, so-called overpowering should mean completely overwhelming, where even without depending on insights of the Spatiotemporal Fusion Rule, one could still dominate the fight against the progenitor of the Tianyu Clan. That is real overpowering.

"Not quite overpowering…" Lin Yi's eyelids twitched.

So, it was an actual fight against a supreme being like the Tianyu Clan?

...

Under the profound starry sky.

Dozens of majestic figures converged here.

If a century ago, the ambushing of the Galaxy Master involved only one entity of the peak races participating at the twelfth layer.

Now, in the Cosmic Starry Skies, aside from nine supremes of human civilization, most of the twelfth layers' ultimate beings were present here.

A century ago, in the eyes of many ultimate twelfth-layer beings, the Galaxy Master was simply a troublesome youngster.

But now, he had become an existence equal to them, and unlike other twelfth layers, the Galaxy Master still had great potential to rise.

He just needs to hit the ultimate, and he could once again achieve a significant metamorphosis and power increase.

"What do we do now?"

"How do we contain the Galaxy Master?"

An ultimate of the twelfth layer spoke, they currently had no intention of eradicating the Galaxy Master, because they couldn't.

"Myriad Transformation has already gone to contact those two ultimates of the Robber Clan."

"If we can convince them, we might still have a chance to contend with the Galaxy Master."

The ultimate from the Prison Tribe slowly said.

The two ultimates of the Robber Clan, both at the pinnacle of the Path Splitting Realm, if they were willing to confront human civilization, to deal with the Galaxy Master, perhaps things wouldn't be as bad as imagined.

Even if the Galaxy Master obtained the pinnacle strength of the Path Splitting Realm shortly after entering the twelfth layer, facing the two pinnacle authorities of the Path Splitting Realm from the Robber Clan, even if these two couldn't normally take action.

They would at least be cautious.

Together with their dozens of twelfth layer ultimates, theoretically, human civilization would still have enemies in the future, unable to dominate alone.

Of course.

No matter what, human civilization becoming the strongest power in the universe, surpassing the ancient Universe Clan and Robber Clan, was already inevitable. The peak races that could once fight against human civilization could only continue to resist by banding together.

"Right, there are also the ultimates of the Robber Clan."

The many twelfth layer ultimates present were slightly startled.

As one of the twelve peak powers of the universe, the Robber Clan would likely not allow human civilization to expand freely, or it would also affect the Robber Clan's own development.

Although previously, the ultimates of the Robber Clan actively withdrew from ambushing the Galaxy Master, in the eyes of many twelfth-layer ultimates, it was probably because the Robber Clan disdained to deal with a mere eleventh-layer entity.

But now the situation is different, if the Robber Clan does nothing now, in the future they will also be oppressed by human civilization.

To a certain extent, currently, the Tianyu Clan, Insect Race, Robber Clan, and other peak races are all standing on the same front, jointly resisting the subsequent expansion of human civilization.

In the waiting period of many twelfth-layer ultimates.

The figure of the Myriad Transformation Queen solidified, clearly having hurried back from the Robber Clan.

"Myriad, how is it? What did those two ultimates of the Robber Clan say?"

"Good, if there are any conditions, just bring it up directly, we will try to satisfy them as much as possible."

The twelfth-layer ultimates immediately asked.

"Myriad, how did the talks go?" The ultimate of the Prison Tribe also inquired.

The Myriad Transformation Queen looked at the expectant gazes of the many twelfth-layer ultimates, and momentarily fell into silence.
